ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE S VISHWAJITH SHETTY

Counsel for the petitioner submits that further proceedings in S.C.No.249/2014 pending before the Court of IX Additional District and Sessions Judge, Bengaluru Rural District, Bengaluru,
registered for offences punishable under Sections 498(A), 304(B) read with Section 34 of IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, are stayed by the co-ordinate Bench of this Court in Crl.P.No.12317/2022 by order dated 22.12.2022 and the said interim order is still in the operation and NC: 2025:KHC:14514 therefore this petition may be dismissed as not pressed at this stage with liberty to the petitioner to renew his application, if need arises.
2. Submission is placed on record.
